item.title: [8] Exotic superconducting states in altermagnets
item.description:
Last authors: Kirill Parshukov, Andreas P. Schnyder

Score 8/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Directly addresses altermagnetism and unconventional superconductivity, both in the user's high-interest topics.

Tags: #altermagnet #superconductivity #symmetry

Abstract: Altermagnets can host superconducting states whose spin-up and spin-down condensates have different spatial pairing patterns. Here, the authors provide a comprehensive catalogue of allowed pairing states and explore their stability and topology. They predict a fractional ac Josephson effect for only one spin polarization in junctions between altermagnetic superconductors.
